mode.title: Scrape Mode
mode.description: daily = new notices since last run (uses stored last_run_date); historical = full 12-month backfill

counties.title: Counties
counties.description: Counties to scrape. Leave empty for all (Travis, Bell, Williamson).

types.title: Notice Types
types.description: Notice types. Leave empty for the default set (foreclosure, probate, tax_sale, tax_delinquent, lien, lis_pendens, fire_damage, condemned). condemned is Travis-only (Austin Building & Standards Commission repair/vacate/demolish orders). code_violation is excluded from the default and is Travis-only (Austin Code Socrata API) — request it explicitly. fire_damage is also Travis-only (CTECC Real-Time Fire Socrata feed) but IS in the default set.

since_date.title: Since Date Override
since_date.description: Pull notices published on or after this date (YYYY-MM-DD). Overrides mode-based date logic and the stored last_run_date.

max_notices.title: Max Notices (smoke-test cap)
max_notices.description: Stop scraping after this many raw notices across all sources. 0 = no cap (default). Useful for smoke-testing the full pipeline without scraping thousands of records.

daily_lookback_days.title: Daily rolling lookback (days)
daily_lookback_days.description: Every daily run re-scans today minus N days .. today on every date-windowed scraper, so rows the clerk posts nameless/addressless are re-hit once completed; cross-run dedup absorbs the repeats. 0 = default (14).

tcc_lookback_days.title: TCC lookback days (backfill)
tcc_lookback_days.description: Widen the Travis tccsearch scrape window beyond the shared daily lookback (only widens, never narrows). Use e.g. 60 for a one-off backfill; leave 0 for normal runs.

bell_ocr_budget_secs.title: Bell foreclosure OCR budget (seconds/run)
bell_ocr_budget_secs.description: Wall-clock budget for OCR-ing Bell County's scanned foreclosure PDFs each run (default 900). Already-read PDFs are remembered and replayed for free, so only new/re-posted/unfinished PDFs spend it. Raise (e.g. 2400) for a one-off backfill.

williamson_ocr_budget_secs.title: Williamson foreclosure OCR budget (seconds/run)
williamson_ocr_budget_secs.description: Wall-clock budget for OCR-ing Williamson County's individual trustee-sale notice PDFs when the clerk has not posted a month's index yet (default 600). Remembered PDFs replay for free. Raise (e.g. 3600) for a one-off backfill.

rebuild_dedup_only.title: Rebuild Dedup Only
rebuild_dedup_only.description: One-shot mode: scrape all sources, seed seen_notice_ids with today's dedup keys, save state, exit WITHOUT running enrichment or sending notifications. Use once after a breaking change to dedup logic.

rebuild_seal_all.title: Rebuild: seal incomplete records too
rebuild_seal_all.description: With Rebuild Dedup Only: seal EVERY scraped record into seen_notice_ids, including ones with no owner name or no address (pre-2026-09-09 behaviour). Default seals only complete records so late-completed clerk rows stay re-scannable.

force_scraper_fail.title: Force Scraper Fail (alert drill)
force_scraper_fail.description: Alert-system drill: 'county/type' (e.g. 'bell/lien') makes that one scraper raise intentionally so you can verify the 🚨 health alert fires. Leave empty in production.

standardize_addresses.title: Standardize addresses (Smarty)
standardize_addresses.description: ON: every address goes through Smarty USPS standardization (Step 6). OFF: addresses are used as scraped.
standardize_addresses.sectionDescription: Every switch here is positive: checked means the step runs. Obituary / Ancestry / heir research were removed from the Actor on 2026-09-17 (DataSift pulls obituaries itself on import); skip tracing runs from the operator box.

geocode_retry.title: Reverse-geocode retry
geocode_retry.description: ON: addresses Smarty could not match get a reverse-geocode + Smarty retry (Step 7). OFF: they stay unmatched.

enrich_cad_tax.title: CAD tax enrichment
enrich_cad_tax.description: ON: Travis / Bell / Williamson appraisal-district lookup fills owner, parcel, assessed value and delinquency (Step 5). OFF: skipped.

enrich_zillow.title: Zillow enrichment
enrich_zillow.description: ON: Zestimate, beds/baths, sqft and MLS status per record (Step 8). This is the slowest enrichment step (~6 s/record). OFF: skipped, and the listed-property filter has nothing to act on.

research_entities.title: Research entity owners (LLC / trust / corp)
research_entities.description: ON: for LLC / Corp / Trust owners, run web search + Claude to find the real person behind the entity (Step 3a). Uses Anthropic credits. OFF: entity owners keep the entity name.

travis_texdel_cleaner.title: Travis tax-delinquent cleaner
travis_texdel_cleaner.description: ON: the Travis roll goes through the skill cleaner (overflow-row merge, address-contamination strip, blank-ZIP resolver). OFF is a safety valve only.

min_delinquent_years.title: Min Years Delinquent (Travis Tax)
min_delinquent_years.description: Travis tax-delinquent: minimum years behind on taxes (default 2).

min_delinquent_amount.title: Min $ Owed (Travis Tax)
min_delinquent_amount.description: Travis tax-delinquent: minimum total owed in dollars (default 3000).

filter_investor_zips.title: Investor-ZIP filter
filter_investor_zips.description: ON: only records in the 34 investor-active ZIPs (target_zips.json) pass (Steps 2a / 8c). OFF: every ZIP is kept.

filter_condos.title: Condo / townhouse / unit filter
filter_condos.description: ON: condos, townhouses and unit-designated addresses (Ste / Unit / Apt / #) are dropped (Step 8a). OFF: kept.

filter_listed_properties.title: Listed-property filter
filter_listed_properties.description: ON: records Zillow shows as Active / Pending / Sold / For Rent are dropped after enrichment (Step 8b). OFF: kept.

drop_government_owned.title: Drop government-owned records
drop_government_owned.description: ON: owners like City Of, Travis County, State Of are left out of the DataSift CSV. OFF: kept.

drop_vacant_land.title: Drop vacant land
drop_vacant_land.description: ON: vacant-land parcels are dropped (Step 3). OFF: kept.

drop_commercial.title: Drop commercial properties
drop_commercial.description: ON: commercial properties are dropped (Step 6a). OFF: kept.

drop_entity_owners.title: Drop entity-owned properties
drop_entity_owners.description: ON: LLC / Corp / Trust owners are dropped unless entity research found a person (Step 3b). OFF: kept.

upload_datasift.title: Auto-upload to DataSift (upload wizard)
upload_datasift.description: After the run, upload each per-notice-type CSV into DataSift through the app's upload wizard (Playwright, headed under Xvfb) — the same path as a manual upload. Each CSV is added to the record type's EXISTING list (Foreclosure, Probate, Liens, ...; no custom batch lists) and every row is tagged upload_YYYY-MM-DD. Then Enrich Property Information + Skip Trace run once on that tag. ~90s per CSV. Uses datasift_email + datasift_password. The Sold/Resolved cleanup CSV is never auto-uploaded.

datasift_enrich_after_upload.title: Enrich in DataSift after upload
datasift_enrich_after_upload.description: ON: after the wizard upload, Manage → Enrich Property Information runs on this run's records (free SiftMap data: beds/baths/Zestimate/sqft; Enrich/Swap Owners stay OFF). Only applies when the upload is on.

datasift_skip_trace_after_upload.title: Skip-trace in DataSift after upload
datasift_skip_trace_after_upload.description: ON: after the wizard upload, Send To → Skip Trace runs on this run's records. OFF by default — turn on only when you want this run skip-traced. Only applies when the upload is on.

datasift_split_by_county.title: Split lead CSVs per county
datasift_split_by_county.description: Write one lead CSV per county+type (e.g. Travis_probate, Bell_probate) for per-county tracking, instead of one combined CSV per type. DataSift list names stay per-type.

notify_slack.title: Send Slack Notification
notify_slack.description: Post run summary + Travis tax-delinquent diff block (NEW/REPEAT/DROPPED) to Slack/Discord webhook.

google_drive_folder_id.title: Google Drive Folder ID (raw records → 00_Inbox/daily)
google_drive_folder_id.description: Drive folder ID for the raw scraped record CSVs — point this at 00_Inbox/daily (these are records, not leads). Leave empty to skip Drive upload.

google_drive_cleanup_folder_id.title: Google Drive Cleanup Folder ID (Sold/Resolved → 03_Sold-Cleanup)
google_drive_cleanup_folder_id.description: Drive folder ID for the drop-off cleanup CSV (Sold + Resolved). Leave empty to nest 03_Sold-Cleanup under the inbox folder instead.

google_drive_forensics_folder_id.title: Google Drive Forensics Folder ID (diff JSON → 04_Forensics-&-Audit)
google_drive_forensics_folder_id.description: Drive folder ID for cross-run diff JSON reports. Leave empty to nest 04_Forensics-&-Audit under the inbox folder instead.

google_drive_auto_folder.title: Auto-organize Drive uploads into dated subfolders
google_drive_auto_folder.description: Sort uploads into Year / MM-Month / County / Type folders instead of dropping them flat (e.g. 2026/07-July/Travis/probate/).

use_residential_proxy.title: Use Residential Proxy
use_residential_proxy.description: ON: requests route through Apify US residential proxies. Travis tccsearch (foreclosure / probate / lien / lis pendens) sits behind Cloudflare and only clears from a US residential IP, so OFF means Travis returns nothing.

state_kvs_name.title: Cross-run State KVS Name
state_kvs_name.description: Name of the cross-run state store. Leave blank for production (sift-stack-state). Set to sift-stack-state-test for a smoke run that must not touch production dedup / sold baselines.

apify_token.title: Apify Personal API Token
apify_token.description: Your Apify Personal API token (Console → Settings → Integrations → Personal API token). Required — Apify's auto-injected run token cannot access the cross-run state KVS. Paste once; scheduled runs inherit it.

anthropic_api_key.title: Anthropic API Key
anthropic_api_key.description: Claude Haiku for LLM parsing + obituary snippet analysis. Recommended.

openwebninja_api_key.title: OpenWeb Ninja API Key (Zillow)
openwebninja_api_key.description: Real-time Zillow Data API. Free tier 100/month.

google_service_account_key.title: Google Service Account Key (base64)
google_service_account_key.description: Base64-encoded service account JSON. Required if google_drive_folder_id is set.

datasift_email.title: DataSift Email
datasift_email.description: app.reisift.io login. Required when upload_datasift is on.

datasift_password.title: DataSift Password
datasift_password.description: app.reisift.io password. Required when upload_datasift is on.

slack_webhook_url.title: Slack / Discord Webhook URL
slack_webhook_url.description: Webhook URL for run summary notifications.
